disposition.reason: 2 Kings 11:14–16. Retired at the study owner's request after attempts to simplify the distractors. Shorter B and C choices still left the item without a single defensible answer. The verses explain why Athaliah had to leave the temple (A), but do not say why the palace grounds were chosen (E). A five-choice review found both A and E defensible in the clean passage and the 15% omission. The proposed rewrites were never published.
